_evidence: One language-file name string of the table at 0x838b99, built by 0x0054e33d: the *.str file name (length < 0x18 checked by cmp eax,0x18 / jae) copied up to '.' or NUL plus a terminating 0, so at most 23 characters + NUL. 0x0054e456/0x0054e491 walk it with cmp byte [edi],0 and rewrite each byte in place (underscore <-> space, case translation). Bytes 0..22 are drawn from letters, '_', ' ', digits, high characters and NUL (an early terminator); byte 23 stays 0 so every string ends inside the buffer.
